feeds.title: Blog
feeds.description: Find advice and information on all things related to Siamese Cats. I love Siamese cats. I was a Siamese cat breeder for over 20 years and bought my first Siamese kitten when I was 17 years old. We have been through it all with our Siamese cats.

feeds.title: Cinema Cats » Siamese
feeds.description: Get to know about movies and television shows where Siamese Cats have made an appearance with Cinema Cats. Cinema Cats is a tribute to the many feline film stars and kitty cameos seen throughout the history of film. Cinema Cats covers all genre of film from around the world, spanning silent 'flickers' to current releases.

feeds.title: Kitten Toob » Siamese
feeds.description: At Kitten Toob, you can find Siamese Cat coverage including news, articles, tips, and videos. Since 2011, Kitten Toob has been entertaining, informing, and educating cat lovers from around the country. Whether it's a video to brighten your day, an inspirational news story, or some helpful tips for cat owners, we've got you covered.

feeds.title: Lai's Lair » Siamese Cats
feeds.description: Visit Lai's Lair and find Cat Information and Advice, including information on Siamese Cats. Elliot here and I'm the owner of Lai's Lair. I'm originally from Ireland but I live in Thailand now with my wife. We're proud owners of a Domestic Shorthair cat called Lai Lai. I started this website because I found myself researching lots of stuff about cats and realizing that I could make a website about cats.

feeds.title: Life with Siamese Cats Blog
feeds.description: The Life with Siamese Cats 'blog' provides a round-up of new pages, features, updates and items of interest sent in by you. The inspiration for Life with Siamese Cats came from my seal point Siamese, Bandit, a rescue cat who came from Siamese Rescue in the UK, where I live.

feeds.title: Kittentanz Blog
feeds.description: Get to know about Siamese Cats, are they good companions, and what you should do to care for your kitten with the Kittentanz Blog. We are a Cattery that specializes in breeding traditional Siamese kittens, otherwise known as 'Applehead' Siamese kittens, and traditional Tonkinese kittens. Owned and operated by Bill and Michelle Harrison, our cattery is registered with CFA, and our kittens are registered with CCR.

feeds.title: Siamese Of Day
feeds.description: Read Siamese Cat Blog Online. Interesting Siamese cat related articles, fun facts, tips, images, owner interviews and their stories at siameseofday.com. We aim at enrichening the special bond between Siamese cats and its owners. Our mission is to expand the popularity of this special breed of cats and provide more information to the general public.

feeds.title: Aimee Zoe Siamese Blog
feeds.description: Are you looking for a Siamese Cat Blog? One that will give you facts and inspiration? My Aimee Zoe Siamese blog will give you the best content. My name is Christine and AimeeZoe Siamese is my GCCF prefix. I've owned Siamese Cats for more than 20 years and have been breeding Siamese cats in the UK since 2017.
